edge.rationale: Recognising nonlinear graphs depends on contrasting changing-rate graphs with previously graphed linear rules.
edge.failure_signal: Learner treats any plotted relationship as linear or cannot use straight-line graphing as the contrast case.

edge.rationale: Plotting paired numerical data depends on interpreting each pair as an ordered pair with distinct first and second coordinates.
edge.failure_signal: Learner swaps the two variables or plots paired values without preserving their order.

edge.rationale: Choosing and reading scatterplot axes depends on reading axis scales accurately.
edge.failure_signal: Learner plots points using grid squares rather than the scale shown on each axis.

operations.rationale: Replace broad curriculum-view prerequisite with learner-state dependencies such as graph_linear_rules requiring plotting points and table/rule graphing skills.
Replace broad curriculum-view prerequisite with learner-state dependencies from gradient/intercept skills to graph_linear_rules, slope_intercept_form, and related concrete states.
Replace broad curriculum-view prerequisite with recognise_nonlinear_graphs requiring graph_linear_rules as the concrete contrast skill.
Replace learner-state-to-curriculum-view prerequisite with recognise_nonlinear_graphs requiring graph_linear_rules.
Replace broad scatterplot curriculum-view prerequisite with concrete learner-state prerequisites for plotting paired data and reading axis scales.
